input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including todo. The platform provides capabilities for todo. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage todo records, so that I can track and organize todo data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with welcome functionality, so that I can accomplish my welcome-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with error functionality, so that I can accomplish my error-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with logout functionality, so that I can accomplish my logout-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
